provenance.title: OpenSpace Milky Way volume
organizations: American Museum of Natural History (Dark Universe model)

license.note: The official asset documentation explicitly licenses this volume MIT. The included OpenSpace MIT notice accompanies the pinned asset/shader; no separate data notice is listed by the synchronization response.

sync.transport: HTTPS equivalent of published HTTP CDN URL

frame.reference: Galactic J2000 centered on Solar System barycenter
frame.conversion: ICRF center minus Sun barycentric position at descriptor epoch; orientation is Galactic-to-ICRF times authored volume rotation.

transfer.pathMetric: Euclidean distance in normalized texture coordinates; per-axis integration divides by that source-axis extent.
transfer.omitted: OpenSpace camera-dependent volume fade, per-ray jitter, additive HDR display, and separate MilkyWayPoints/halo star renderer; cssEarth retains its independently sourced star field.
transfer.cssApproximation: CSS slabs integrate common physical/source distance on all axes to avoid an axis-dependent optical coefficient. OpenSpace instead integrates normalized texture distance; exact additive raymarch photometry is not reproduced. Display exposure gain 16 is applied after integration and balanced against the NASA interior panorama. Display gain is an authored presentation parameter, not a published OpenSpace source parameter.

cssTextureEncoding.note: RGB is perceptually compressed; alpha texels are preserved exactly. Source RGBA scientific volume remains lossless and unchanged.

transfer.cssSampling: 256 X/Y slabs and 32 Z slabs have equal physical/source pitch 0.0078125; each Z slab integrates 4 samples at the original 128 source Z texel centres. In-plane texture width remains 1024; no adaptive image resampling.

cssDisplayColorGrade.space: Ordinary display RGB after exponential transfer; one linear matrix on premultiplied emitted RGB with alpha unchanged. This is not linear-light photometry.
cssDisplayColorGrade.reference: NASA original Milky Way-only preview; matched ICRF rays at the Sun, fit independently of luminance.
cssDisplayColorGrade.scope: Same coefficients for every slab and axis, observer position and distance. No added desaturation; source emission/absorption coefficients and scientific input bytes unchanged.

derivative.error: Lossless container conversion: decoded bytes are identical to every byte of the original published raw volume; no source averaging or quantization.

catalogueDisplay.description: OpenSpace Milky Way volume. Jon Parker, Emil Axelsson, Carter Emmart, OpenSpace Team. National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (simulation); American Museum of Natural History (Dark Universe model); OpenSpace Project (volume adaptation).

approximation.method: Filtered scalar fields; decoded after filtering; integrated emission/absorption; symmetric slab attenuation; exponential energy in ordinary alpha.
limitations: Ordinary alpha approximates emitted light and wavelength-dependent extinction.
Finite slices and axis handoffs approximate a continuous field; angle-dependent opacity and sampling differences remain.
The display color matrix transforms ordinary display RGB values; it is not linear-light photometry.
No runtime ray integration, near-field noise or global HDR display pass.
